tips.text: Bank 400 Ducats and keep a stock of Prime parts to sell before Baro arrives, so his visit is just a kiosk trip.
Run Void Cascade or Defense fissures with a speed frame such as Nova, or quick Capture and Exterminate runs, to open a relic every minute or two.
Join a squad where everyone runs the same unrefined relic; four of them give a better chance at good Ducat drops than refining your own.
Spend spare syndicate standing on relic packs for extra relics to crack.
Do not sell Prime parts you still need for your own builds just to reach 400 Ducats.
Buy it on the first visit that stocks it; it can be months before Baro brings it back.
Nobody minds the cost; the only complaint is waiting for Baro to stock it.
Treat it as a Mastery purchase; players call it one of the weakest secondaries.
